==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Everything feels very normal at first. That is until I encounter a bald man with round glasses, blue eyes, and a gray sweater sitting at a wooden table in front of a green wall. The man tells me that his son and I are meant to go upstairs and create a man out of aluminum foil.

I am so caught off guard by what he said, that I no longer believe that the world around me is real. But I don't become lucid. Instead, I suggest that the writer of reality must have become bored and I visualize said writer as a woman with curly brown hair and blue eyes wearing a pink sweater and writing in a notebook.

I go up a flight of wooden stairs. Alongside the bald man's son, I start to construct a man made of aluminum foil. The man made of aluminum foil springs to life and names himself 'Dr. Breakneck'.

'Dr. Breakneck' starts jumping around, dancing, and singing his name over and over again. This surprises me enough to actually wake me up. I was thinking a lot about everything having auras the other day and whether or not everything were alive in some way.

I wonder if that's what inspired me to dream of a man made of aluminum foil coming to life?
